body:
Adds capture-scoped contribution observations, bounded immutable recording/metadata storage, authoritative enrollment/policy handling and authenticated upload/retry/receipt settlement. Reuses the recognition engine and actual executor outcomes; contribution work stays separate from recognition and playback actions. The service retains the sharing model/trigger and cleans up registrations when released.

This is the complete standalone upload range: 197 commits / 69 files. Preserve its review/fix history. Auth/password and cloud-player/tail fixes from PR56–58 are not included; cloud/playback changes here report contribution outcomes.

Draft and unready. Product UI/upload trigger are compiled off; that constant is not collection authority. Remote policy plus authoritative enrollment/consent remains the gate, and actual remote/account activation state is unverified. No new build-time collection authority is introduced. Account enrollment/withdrawal/server-deletion now has the existing account navigation and a lifecycle-bound screen using the reviewed account model. Twelve focused model/navigation controls pass, with legible simulator renders and no account actions after signout. This is rendered-view/source-binding evidence, not interactive tap acceptance. Production enrollment is unavailable without an approved disclosure version; withdrawal and deletion remain independent, with deletion acknowledgement pending only. Upload network admission, path-loss cancellation and actual request restrictions are implemented for validated noncellular/any-connected allowances; production allowance remains unavailable pending owner selection. Seven focused controls pass, including real loopback cancellation/immutable retry and the prior configured upload control. Physical cellular routing and background delivery remain unverified. Authenticated plan and enrollment attributes now request Analytics user-property publication with privacy/session fencing; local controls pass, while Firebase delivery and targeting acceptance remain unverified. No activation is authorized.

Validation is scoped, not a whole-feature or full-suite pass. Recent independently peer-verified host controls cover real signout/account-deletion purge, service dependency lifetime, policy-disable purge/cancel/join, enrollment lookup stale-response/follow-up behavior and configured loopback upload 503/retry with immutable bytes and matching receipt settlement. Earlier complete-class attempt records 30 passed / 1 cancelled in an old full-model cold-start test; it is not a 49-test pass. Queue-root backup exclusion now uses the platform property with uncached readback before recovery/retention/serving; three focused controls pass, and setter/readback omission controls fail. This verifies property enforcement and failure/recovery behavior on the test host, not OS backup-service behavior or removal of existing copies. Detailed receipts and acceptance reconciliation accompany the review packet.

Full-range source review remains outstanding. Firebase SDK execution, model-loading service assembly, device/background/network behavior, live server acceptance, acoustic behavior, propagation latency and cost are not established by the local controls. Backend dataset deletion/export/retention acceptance belongs to its owning lane. No merge or owner installation included.
title: Add Voice Sharing collection records and durable authenticated uploads
